share.label: a loaf now belongs to the companion
the loaf left the hero's inventory

gift.note: A gift from the organiser: two loaves created for the hero.

rounds.text: The organiser pulls two loaves from under the counter and pushes them across. "For the road. Don't say the square never fed you."

recruit.note: A new companion: a character with party membership.

rounds.text: Tamsin, a young drover with a switch over her shoulder, listens, shrugs, and grins. "Same road, better company. Why not."

arguments.name: Tamsin
arguments.description: A young drover heading the same way.

current.goal: get her herd money to the coast

eat.note: Eating is consuming a consumable; no healing rule is needed.

rounds.text: You sit on the well's edge and tear into one loaf.
Good bread; the square's noise fades for a while.

share.note: Giving the other loaf to the companion is a transfer.

rounds.text: You hold out the second loaf.
Tamsin takes it without ceremony and tucks it into her pack. "Later. Walking first."
